evidence: A cycling sequence of WF6/NH3/C2H4/SiH4/NH3 was applied to deposit WxN1−x films after an N2-purge pulse. Deposition conditions noted as, e.g., 1/2/3/2/2 refer to the reactant pulse lengths in seconds: 1 s for the WF6 pulse, 2 s for NH3, 3 s for C2H4, 2 s for SiH4, and 2 s for NH3 with pure N2 purges of 2 s between each reactive gas pulse.
